subject: Intercom renewal: Support & Success platform renewal + SOW alignment
messages:
From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
To: Sarah Hayes <sarah.hayes@intercom.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 02 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intercom renewal: initial scope + SOW request

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for sending the preliminary renewal numbers last week. We're kicking off a quick internal review for Support & Success tooling across CS and Ops to decide whether to renew Intercom for another year or re-evaluate alternatives. Goal is to finalize vendor decision by 2026-05-12 so we can hit fiscal procurement windows.

A few asks from our side to move quickly:
- Can you share the official renewal quote and the latest SOW (we have a draft but want the canonical one)?
- Any promotional pricing or multi-year discounts available for 12-month vs 24-month commitments?
- Confirmation of data retention/custom export options for chat transcripts and webhook history (we need 24-month exports for compliance).

I've attached our high level usage and seat counts (internal). If you can return a PDF quote and a track-changed SOW, that would speed legal review.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Customer Success Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood-Usage-Summary-May2026.csv (CSV)]

From: Sarah Hayes <sarah.hayes@intercom.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: renewals@intercom.com
Date: Sat, 02 May 2026 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intercom renewal: initial scope + SOW request

Stephanie —

Thanks for the note and timeline. I attached the formal renewal quote and a fresh SOW based on your usage numbers. Quick highlights:
- 12-month renewal price: $82,500 (annual invoiced) with standard support.
- 24-month option: $154,000 (5% effective discount) with one implementation day credit.
- We can set exports to a 24-month retention window and provide a one-time bulk export on request.

Attached: Intercom-Renewal-Quote-2026.pdf, SOW-CS-Integration-v1.docx

If you want, we can do a short call Monday to walk the SOW redlines before legal.

Best,
Sarah Hayes
Enterprise Renewals
Intercom
[Attachment: Intercom-Renewal-Quote-2026.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: SOW-CS-Integration-v1.docx (DOCX)]

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Cc: rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 04 May 2026 08:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intercom renewal: initial scope + SOW request

Looping in CS and Ops notes. Quick read: the price is in line with last year but the integration work in the SOW looks heavier than expected — there's an extra engineering day bucket for custom webhooks and a data mapping task.

Questions for vendor before we send to legal:
- Can Intercom narrow the integration scope to only core webhook delivery + one canonical transcript export? That drops ~8 eng hours we don't have on the calendar.
- What SLAs are included for webhook delivery and historical export? We should confirm RTO for exports.

If renewals team can offer a signed credit for one implementation day (as Sarah mentioned for 24-month), that might be the fastest path. Otherwise we risk opening a procurement review for 3rd-party implementation support.

Next steps:
1) Stephanie — would you prefer we ask Sarah for a trimmed SOW or just share the redlines with legal?
2) Connor — can you estimate the eng lift for the current SOW so we can quantify cost vs credit?

—Marissa
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 04 May 2026 12:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intercom renewal: initial scope + SOW request

Marissa / team —

Estimate: the items flagged add about 10–12 engineering hours for the initial integration (webhook schema validation, one-off export script, QA). If we include automation for mapping historical transcripts into our analytics pipeline it's another 16–24 hours. If Intercom will accept delivering only the webhook + single export, we can do it in the 10–12 hour bucket and push the rest to Q3.

Cost-equivalent: 10–12 hours ~ $3.6k in internal effort (benchmarked at $300/hr for eng resource planning). If Intercom will provide the one implementation day credit for the 24-month, it's an easy trade-off.

I'll attach a short engineering note for legal review.

—Connor
Platform Engineer, Integrations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Integration-Labor-Estimate-Redwood.pdf (PDF)]

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
To: Sarah Hayes <sarah.hayes@intercom.com>, renewals@intercom.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai, rachel_kim@redwood.ai, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acct-legal.com>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2026 16:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intercom renewal: Support & Success platform renewal + SOW alignment

Hi Sarah — thanks for the quick turnaround and attachments.

We ran internal triage and would like to request a trimmed SOW that scopes implementation to: webhook delivery (canonically formatted), one bulk transcript export, and standard admin onboarding. Can you return a version with those deliverables removed from the SOW implementation bucket? If you can also confirm the SLA for export completion (acceptable RTO) that would be great — we need to include that in procurement.

We are prepared to sign the 12-month if you can provide either:
- a written confirmation to remove the extra engineering items from the SOW, or
- the 24-month price with the one implementation day credit (we prefer the 12-month but can consider 24 if the credit offsets the extra scope).

Tom from legal is cc'd and will issue redlines once the trimmed SOW is returned. Our procurement deadline is 2026-05-12. Can you confirm a time for the call to review redlines tomorrow (2026-05-05) morning PT?

Appreciate the help —
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Customer Success Operations
Redwood Inference
